profile.headline: Solutions Architect | Cloud Modernization | Enterprise Integration | Technology Leadership
profile.summary:
Technology leader and Solutions Architect with 10+ years of experience designing and delivering enterprise software solutions across insurance, financial services, claims processing, billing, CRM, and partner integration platforms. I specialize in translating complex business requirements into scalable, secure, and maintainable architectures while helping teams deliver high-quality solutions at enterprise scale.

Throughout my career, I have progressed from software engineering into technical leadership, serving as a trusted advisor for architecture decisions, integration strategies, cloud modernization, and engineering practices. My experience spans the Microsoft ecosystem, including C#, .NET, SQL Server, Azure DevOps, microservices, CI/CD, enterprise integrations, and cloud technologies across AWS and Azure.

I have led modernization initiatives, complex client integrations, cloud migrations, platform development, and technology adoption efforts. My experience includes systems supporting hundreds of millions of dollars in annual business transactions, payment processing, claims management, and large-scale application modernization.

Beyond technology, I enjoy helping teams grow and solve difficult problems. I mentor developers, conduct technical interviews, lead design discussions, establish engineering standards, and collaborate across teams to turn complex technical challenges into practical solutions.

I’m particularly interested in technology architecture, cloud modernization, enterprise integration, emerging technologies, and building solutions that create meaningful business impact.

positions.title: Senior Software Developer
positions.description:
- Designed, developed, supported, and modernized web applications, APIs, microservices, and SOAP/REST services using .NET, C#, SQL Server, React, RabbitMQ, SSIS/SSRS, and Azure DevOps.
- Led architecture and implementation of warranty solutions integrating Avalara, Orbital Paymentech, Apple GSX/Pay, CardConnect, ACH, and TransUnion.
- Integrated major clients including Apple, Best Buy, HWA, ARW, NJR, Lennox, Rheem, Carrier, Constellation, TikTok, Sure, NewLeaf, Energy Texas, Flex, Prosurety, and additional clients into self-service and internal platforms.
- Built a reusable processor for onboarding clients and loading sales and claims data through files and APIs.
- Led teams through complex client integrations and coordinated releases across multiple application streams.
- Modernized 48 applications from .NET Core 2.1 to .NET 8 and upgraded Node.js components while maintaining continuity and addressing vulnerabilities.
- Migrated legacy clients to a modern platform, improving performance and modernizing the technology stack.
- Led MongoDB integration for a high-volume logging service, including architecture, stress testing, and performance analysis.
- Designed a white-label platform enabling client-specific branding across shared warranty solutions.
- Automated deployment and infrastructure processes using PowerShell and Azure DevOps, supporting migration from on-premises servers to AWS.
- Migrated the Warranty Information Service Hub from on-premises infrastructure to AWS.
- Spearheaded AI adoption initiatives within the Warranty division, evaluating GitHub Copilot and Claude Code through multiple POCs.
- Supported RabbitMQ/Erlang upgrades and data migration using the shovel plugin while maintaining message integrity.

positions.title: Software Development Contractor
positions.description:
-Design, development, support and maintenance for websites, web applications, web hooks, microservices, web API, web services (SOAP, REST) ​​using ASP .NET, .NET MVC 5, .NET Framework 4.x, SQL Server 2016, SSRS, SSIS, Rabbit MQ, jQuery, JavaScript, Bootstrap 3, Foundation 5, React JS
-Migrated a web service to implement Avalara Tax suite, feature that was used across multiple applications.
-Supported and developed new features for clients like Best Buy, Otterbox,LG and Apple, maintaining  self service and internal applications.

positions.description:
-Lead a team of 4 developers during the development phase of the project. Requirements gathering and analysis. Responsible for creating technical design document based on functional and business requirement document, used MS Project to schedule the tasks and stages of a project.
-Design, development, support and maintenance for Websites, Web applications, Web API's, Web Services (SOAP, REST) using ASP .NET, .NET MVC 5, .NET Framework 4.x, SQL Server 2016, Oracle 12c, SSRS, SSDT, Azure (DevOps, Functions, Blob storage, Powershell, SQL), jQuery, JavaScript, Bootstrap 3, Razor, LINQ, Entity Framework 6.0, DevExpress 12.x; focusing on the following processes: Finances, Procurement and Supply, HR and Billing.
-Integrated systems with SAP using SAP Connector 3.0 and with EMC Documentum.
-Developed front-end functionality using jQuery, Razor, Datatables, Bootstrap, CSS 3, etc. Created rich user experience using AJAX, JSON, XML and integrating and deploying the code.
-Used TFS, Git and Azure VSTS as Source Control. Developed Web applications with SAP using SAP Connector 3.0 and with EMC Documentum.
